q: Dalam analisis ABC persediaan, barang kelas A adalah barang yang...
o: Bernilai tinggi dengan jumlah jenis sedikit dan dikontrol paling ketat
Bernilai rendah dengan jumlah jenis paling banyak
e: Kelas A: sedikit jenis tetapi menyumbang nilai terbesar, sehingga mendapat pengawasan paling ketat.
q_en: In ABC inventory analysis, class A items are those that...
o_en: Are high in value, few in number of types, and controlled most tightly
Are low in value with the most types
Have been in the warehouse longest
Are returned most often by customers
e_en: Class A is a few item types that account for the largest value, so they get the tightest control.

q: Apa fungsi safety stock?
o: Cadangan untuk menahan lonjakan permintaan atau keterlambatan pasok
Barang yang sengaja ditahan agar harga naik
e: Safety stock adalah persediaan tambahan sebagai penyangga ketidakpastian permintaan dan waktu tunggu pemasok.
q_en: What is the purpose of safety stock?
o_en: A buffer against demand spikes or late supply
Goods deliberately held back to push prices up
e_en: Safety stock is extra inventory that buffers uncertain demand and supplier lead time.

q: Permintaan tahunan 1.000 unit, biaya sekali pesan Rp50, biaya simpan Rp10 per unit per tahun. Berapa EOQ (rumus akar dari 2DS/H)?
q_en: Annual demand is 1,000 units, ordering cost Rp50 per order, holding cost Rp10 per unit per year. What is the EOQ (square root of 2DS/H)?

q: Penjualan 10 unit per hari, lead time pemasok 14 hari, safety stock 30 unit. Berapa titik pemesanan ulang (reorder point)?
e: Reorder point = permintaan harian x lead time + safety stock = 10 x 14 + 30 = 170 unit.
q_en: Sales are 10 units a day, supplier lead time is 14 days, safety stock is 30 units. What is the reorder point?
e_en: Reorder point = daily demand x lead time + safety stock = 10 x 14 + 30 = 170 units.

q: HPP setahun Rp600 juta dan rata-rata persediaan Rp100 juta. Berapa perputaran persediaannya?
e: Perputaran persediaan = HPP / rata-rata persediaan = 600 / 100 = 6 kali setahun.
q_en: Annual cost of goods sold is Rp600 million and average inventory is Rp100 million. What is inventory turnover?
e_en: Inventory turnover = COGS / average inventory = 600 / 100 = 6 times a year.

q: Dokumen resmi yang dikirim pembeli kepada pemasok untuk memesan barang disebut...
e: Purchase order (PO) adalah pesanan pembelian resmi dari pembeli kepada pemasok.
q_en: The formal document a buyer sends a supplier to order goods is called a...
e_en: A purchase order (PO) is the buyer's formal order to the supplier.

q: Kapan request for quotation (RFQ) paling tepat dipakai?
o: Saat spesifikasi barang sudah jelas dan yang dibandingkan terutama harga
Saat solusi yang dibutuhkan belum diketahui
e: RFQ meminta harga untuk spesifikasi yang sudah ditetapkan; RFP dipakai bila pemasok diminta mengusulkan solusi.
q_en: When is a request for quotation (RFQ) most suitable?
o_en: When the specification is clear and price is the main comparison
When the needed solution is not yet known
After the goods have been received
When a supplier is about to be terminated
e_en: An RFQ asks for prices on a fixed specification; an RFP is used when suppliers are asked to propose a solution.

q: Perusahaan belum tahu sistem apa yang terbaik dan meminta pemasok mengajukan usulan solusi beserta harganya. Dokumen apa yang dipakai?
e: RFP dipakai bila pemasok diminta mengusulkan solusi, bukan hanya menawarkan harga untuk barang yang sudah ditentukan.
q_en: A company does not yet know which system is best and asks suppliers to propose a solution and a price. Which document is used?
e_en: An RFP is used when suppliers are asked to propose a solution, not only quote a price for a fixed item.

q: Three-way matching sebelum membayar pemasok mencocokkan tiga dokumen apa?
o: Purchase order, tanda terima barang, dan faktur pemasok
Faktur, laporan pajak, dan surat jalan
e: Pembayaran baru dilakukan bila PO, tanda terima barang, dan faktur pemasok cocok.
q_en: Three-way matching before paying a supplier compares which three documents?
o_en: Purchase order, goods receipt and supplier invoice
Invoice, tax report and delivery note
e_en: Payment is made only when the PO, the goods receipt and the supplier invoice agree.

q: Mana pendekatan yang paling tepat dalam mengevaluasi penawaran pemasok?
o: Menilai beberapa kriteria berbobot: harga, kualitas, ketepatan kirim, dan risiko
Memilih harga terendah tanpa melihat hal lain
Memilih pemasok yang paling lama dikenal
e: Evaluasi yang baik memakai kriteria berbobot, bukan hanya harga, karena biaya total mencakup kualitas dan risiko pasok.
q_en: Which approach is best for evaluating supplier bids?
o_en: Score several weighted criteria: price, quality, delivery reliability and risk
Pick the lowest price and ignore the rest
Pick the supplier known the longest
Pick the one that replies fastest
e_en: A good evaluation uses weighted criteria, not price alone, because total cost includes quality and supply risk.

q: Apa itu supplier scorecard?
o: Kartu penilaian kinerja pemasok berdasarkan kualitas, pengiriman, dan harga
Kontrak jangka panjang dengan satu pemasok
e: Supplier scorecard mengukur kinerja pemasok secara berkala terhadap indikator yang disepakati.
q_en: What is a supplier scorecard?
o_en: A rating of supplier performance on quality, delivery and price
A price list of all suppliers
A long-term contract with one supplier
e_en: A supplier scorecard measures supplier performance regularly against agreed indicators.

q: Apa itu SLA dengan pemasok?
o: Kesepakatan tingkat layanan yang terukur, misalnya waktu pengiriman
e: Service level agreement menetapkan standar layanan yang terukur dan konsekuensi bila tidak terpenuhi.
q_en: What is an SLA with a supplier?
o_en: A measurable service-level agreement, such as delivery time
e_en: A service level agreement sets measurable service standards and the consequence of missing them.

q: Apa fungsi daftar pemasok terdaftar (approved vendor list)?
o: Menjadi daftar pemasok yang sudah lolos evaluasi dan boleh dipilih
Mencatat semua pemasok yang pernah ditolak
e: Hanya pemasok yang lolos evaluasi awal masuk daftar sehingga pembelian dilakukan dari sumber yang sudah terpercaya.
q_en: What is the purpose of an approved vendor list?
o_en: To list suppliers that passed evaluation and may be chosen
To record every supplier ever rejected
To set the selling price of products
To store the supplier's employee data
e_en: Only suppliers that passed initial evaluation are listed, so purchases come from trusted sources.

q: Apa risiko utama bergantung pada satu pemasok tunggal (single sourcing)?
o: Pasok berhenti total bila pemasok itu mengalami gangguan
e: Dengan satu pemasok, gangguan di sana langsung menghentikan pasok; pemasok cadangan mengurangi risiko itu.
q_en: What is the main risk of relying on a single supplier (single sourcing)?
o_en: Supply stops entirely if that supplier is disrupted
e_en: With one supplier, a disruption there stops supply at once; a back-up supplier reduces that risk.

q: Pemasok mencapai OTIF 82% padahal target 95%. Tindakan yang paling tepat?
o: Menelusuri penyebab bersama pemasok dan menyepakati rencana perbaikan terukur
e: Kinerja di bawah target perlu dianalisis penyebabnya dan diperbaiki lewat rencana yang disepakati dan dipantau.
q_en: A supplier reaches 82% OTIF against a 95% target. What is the best action?
o_en: Find the causes with the supplier and agree a measurable improvement plan
Terminate the contract at once without discussion
Ignore it because it is above 80%
e_en: Performance below target should be analysed for causes and fixed with an agreed, monitored plan.

q: Apa fungsi utama sistem manajemen gudang (WMS)?
o: Mengelola lokasi, penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan pengambilan barang di gudang
e: WMS membantu mengatur pergerakan dan penyimpanan barang di gudang secara terlacak.
q_en: What is the main function of a warehouse management system (WMS)?
o_en: Managing locations, receiving, storage and picking of goods in a warehouse
e_en: A WMS helps control the movement and storage of goods in a warehouse with full tracking.

q: Apa yang dimaksud logistik inbound?
o: Penerimaan barang yang masuk dari pemasok
e: Inbound adalah arus barang masuk dari pemasok; outbound adalah arus barang keluar ke pelanggan.
q_en: What is inbound logistics?
o_en: Receiving goods that come in from suppliers
Returning damaged goods to the warehouse
e_en: Inbound is the flow of goods in from suppliers; outbound is the flow out to customers.

q: Setelah barang diterima dan diperiksa, tahap memindahkannya ke lokasi rak yang ditentukan disebut...
e: Putaway adalah penempatan barang yang sudah diterima ke lokasi penyimpanan yang tepat.
q_en: After goods are received and checked, moving them to their assigned shelf location is called...
e_en: Putaway is placing received goods into the right storage location.

q: Barang dari truk pemasok langsung dipindah ke truk pengiriman pelanggan tanpa disimpan lama. Apa istilahnya?
e: Cross-docking memindahkan barang dari area penerimaan ke pengiriman tanpa penyimpanan panjang.
q_en: Goods move from the supplier's truck straight to the customer delivery truck without long storage. What is this called?
e_en: Cross-docking moves goods from receiving to shipping without long-term storage.

q: Perusahaan menyerahkan penyimpanan dan pengiriman barangnya kepada penyedia jasa logistik luar. Model apa ini?
e: 3PL adalah penggunaan penyedia jasa logistik pihak ketiga untuk pergudangan dan transportasi.
q_en: A company hands its storage and delivery of goods to an outside logistics provider. What model is this?
e_en: 3PL means using a third-party provider for warehousing and transport.

q: Masukan utama perhitungan MRP adalah...
o: Jadwal induk produksi, bill of materials, dan status persediaan
Laporan laba rugi, neraca, dan arus kas
e: MRP memakai jadwal induk produksi (MPS), BOM, dan data persediaan untuk menghitung kebutuhan material.
q_en: The main inputs to an MRP calculation are...
o_en: The master production schedule, bill of materials and inventory status
Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow
e_en: MRP uses the master production schedule (MPS), the BOM and inventory records to compute material needs.

q: Apa itu bill of materials (BOM)?
o: Daftar bahan dan komponen beserta jumlah untuk membuat satu produk
e: BOM merinci semua bahan, komponen, dan jumlahnya yang dibutuhkan untuk satu unit produk jadi.
q_en: What is a bill of materials (BOM)?
o_en: A list of materials and components with quantities needed to make one product
An invoice from a materials supplier
e_en: A BOM details all materials, components and quantities needed for one finished unit.

q: Kebutuhan kotor suatu komponen 500 unit, persediaan di tangan 120, dan penerimaan terjadwal 80. Berapa kebutuhan bersih?
e: Kebutuhan bersih = kebutuhan kotor - persediaan - penerimaan terjadwal = 500 - 120 - 80 = 300.
q_en: Gross requirement for a component is 500 units, on-hand stock is 120 and scheduled receipts are 80. What is the net requirement?
e_en: Net requirement = gross - on hand - scheduled receipts = 500 - 120 - 80 = 300.

q: Apa yang dinyatakan jadwal induk produksi (MPS)?
o: Produk jadi apa yang dibuat, berapa banyak, dan kapan
Siapa yang bekerja di lini produksi
e: MPS menetapkan jumlah dan waktu produksi produk jadi, yang kemudian diuraikan MRP menjadi kebutuhan material.
q_en: What does the master production schedule (MPS) state?
o_en: Which finished products are made, how many and when
Who works on the production line
e_en: The MPS sets the quantity and timing of finished products, which MRP then breaks into material needs.

q: Material dibutuhkan pada 30 Juni dan lead time pemasok 10 hari. Kapan pesanan paling lambat dilepas?
e: Tanggal pelepasan pesanan = tanggal dibutuhkan - lead time = 30 Juni - 10 hari = 20 Juni.
q_en: Material is needed on 30 June and the supplier lead time is 10 days. By when must the order be released?
e_en: Order release date = due date - lead time = 30 June - 10 days = 20 June.

q: Apa itu work breakdown structure (WBS)?
o: Pemecahan hasil kerja proyek menjadi komponen yang lebih kecil dan mudah dikelola
e: WBS memecah seluruh ruang lingkup proyek secara hierarkis menjadi komponen yang lebih kecil.
q_en: What is a work breakdown structure (WBS)?
o_en: A breakdown of project deliverables into smaller manageable components
A list of project team members
e_en: A WBS breaks the whole project scope down hierarchically into smaller components.

q: Tingkat terendah dalam WBS yang dipakai untuk estimasi dan penugasan disebut...
e: Work package adalah unit kerja terkecil di WBS yang dapat diestimasi, dijadwalkan, dan ditugaskan.
q_en: The lowest level of a WBS, used for estimating and assignment, is called a...
e_en: A work package is the smallest unit in the WBS that can be estimated, scheduled and assigned.

q: Apa isi aturan 100% pada WBS?
o: WBS harus mencakup seluruh ruang lingkup proyek, tidak kurang dan tidak lebih
Setiap tugas harus selesai 100% tepat waktu
e: Aturan 100%: seluruh pekerjaan proyek harus tercakup oleh WBS, dan tidak ada pekerjaan di luar ruang lingkup.
q_en: What does the 100% rule for a WBS say?
o_en: The WBS must cover all of the project scope, no less and no more
Every task must finish 100% on time
e_en: The 100% rule: all project work must be covered by the WBS, with no work outside the scope.

q: Mana elemen WBS yang berorientasi pada hasil kerja (deliverable)?
e: WBS disusun berdasarkan deliverable (apa yang dihasilkan), bukan kegiatan rutin seperti rapat.
q_en: Which WBS element is oriented to a deliverable?
e_en: A WBS is built on deliverables (what is produced), not routine activities such as meetings.

q: Manfaat utama WBS bagi koordinator proyek adalah...
o: Dasar untuk estimasi, penjadwalan, dan pembagian tanggung jawab
e: WBS menjadi dasar estimasi biaya dan waktu, penjadwalan, serta penugasan tanggung jawab.
q_en: The main benefit of a WBS for a project coordinator is...
o_en: A basis for estimating, scheduling and assigning responsibility
A replacement for the project budget
A guarantee there are no risks
No more need to talk to the client
e_en: A WBS is the basis for cost and time estimates, scheduling and assigning responsibility.

q: Apa yang ditampilkan diagram Gantt?
o: Kegiatan proyek sebagai batang pada garis waktu
e: Diagram Gantt menunjukkan kegiatan, durasi, dan urutan waktunya sebagai batang pada sumbu waktu.
q_en: What does a Gantt chart show?
o_en: Project activities as bars on a timeline
e_en: A Gantt chart shows activities, their durations and timing as bars on a time axis.

q: Apa itu jalur kritis (critical path)?
o: Rangkaian kegiatan terpanjang yang menentukan durasi minimum proyek
e: Jalur kritis adalah urutan kegiatan terpanjang; keterlambatannya langsung memundurkan seluruh proyek.
q_en: What is the critical path?
o_en: The longest chain of activities, setting the minimum project duration
The activities with the greatest risk
The activities done by the manager
e_en: The critical path is the longest sequence of activities; delaying it delays the whole project.

q: Kegiatan A (2 hari) dilanjutkan B (3 hari) dan C (4 hari) secara paralel, lalu D (1 hari) setelah keduanya selesai. Berapa durasi minimum proyek?
e: Jalur A-C-D = 2 + 4 + 1 = 7 hari lebih panjang dari A-B-D = 6 hari, sehingga durasi minimum 7 hari.
q_en: Activity A (2 days) is followed by B (3 days) and C (4 days) in parallel, then D (1 day) after both finish. What is the minimum project duration?
e_en: Path A-C-D = 2 + 4 + 1 = 7 days is longer than A-B-D = 6 days, so the minimum duration is 7 days.

q: Berapa nilai float (slack) kegiatan yang berada di jalur kritis?
e: Kegiatan di jalur kritis tidak punya kelonggaran: float-nya nol.
q_en: What is the float (slack) of an activity on the critical path?
e_en: Activities on the critical path have no slack: their float is zero.

q: Sebuah kegiatan di jalur kritis terlambat 2 hari dan tidak ada percepatan. Apa dampaknya?
e: Keterlambatan pada jalur kritis langsung menggeser tanggal selesai proyek sebesar jumlah keterlambatan.
q_en: An activity on the critical path is 2 days late and there is no crashing. What is the effect?
o_en: The whole project slips by 2 days
e_en: A delay on the critical path shifts the project end date by the amount of the delay.

q: Apa yang dimaksud scope creep?
o: Penambahan ruang lingkup proyek tanpa kontrol formal
e: Scope creep adalah bertambahnya pekerjaan di luar rencana awal tanpa penyesuaian jadwal dan biaya.
q_en: What is scope creep?
o_en: Added project scope without formal control
A gradual cut in the budget
A faster schedule at no extra cost
e_en: Scope creep is work growing beyond the original plan without adjusting schedule and cost.

q: Untuk apa permintaan perubahan (change request) dipakai?
o: Mengelola perubahan ruang lingkup secara formal dan tertulis
e: Change request mencatat perubahan yang diminta agar dampaknya dinilai dan disetujui sebelum dikerjakan.
q_en: What is a change request used for?
o_en: Managing scope changes formally and in writing
e_en: A change request records a requested change so its impact is assessed and approved before work starts.

q: Apa langkah pertama ketika menerima permintaan perubahan dari klien?
o: Menilai dampaknya pada ruang lingkup, jadwal, dan biaya
Mengubah anggaran tanpa memberi tahu klien
e: Dampak perubahan dinilai dulu agar keputusan menerima atau menolak didasarkan pada angka.
q_en: What is the first step when a change request arrives from a client?
o_en: Assess the impact on scope, schedule and cost
Start working on it right away
Change the budget without telling the client
e_en: The impact is assessed first so the decision to accept or reject rests on numbers.

q: Apa kepanjangan dari RAID dalam log proyek?
e: RAID log mencatat risiko, asumsi, isu, dan ketergantungan proyek di satu tempat.
q_en: What does RAID stand for in a project log?
e_en: A RAID log records a project's risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies in one place.

q: Di tengah proyek klien meminta fitur tambahan tetapi anggaran dan jadwal tetap. Respons terbaik?
o: Ajukan change request, nilai dampaknya, lalu minta persetujuan sebelum mengerjakan
Mulai bekerja lalu memberi tahu setelah selesai
e: Fitur tambahan harus lewat pengendalian perubahan agar jadwal dan biaya disesuaikan dan disetujui.
q_en: Mid-project the client asks for an extra feature while budget and schedule stay fixed. What is the best response?
o_en: Raise a change request, assess the impact and get approval before working
Do it quietly to please the client
Start the work and tell them afterwards
e_en: An extra feature should go through change control so schedule and cost are adjusted and approved.

q: Apa fungsi roadmap produk?
o: Menggambarkan arah dan prioritas pengembangan produk dari waktu ke waktu
e: Roadmap mengomunikasikan tujuan, prioritas, dan urutan pengembangan produk kepada tim dan pemangku kepentingan.
q_en: What is the purpose of a product roadmap?
o_en: To show the direction and priorities of product development over time
e_en: A roadmap communicates goals, priorities and the order of product development to the team and stakeholders.

q: Kepanjangan huruf-huruf pada metode prioritisasi MoSCoW adalah...
e: MoSCoW membagi kebutuhan menjadi Must have, Should have, Could have, dan Won't have (kali ini).
q_en: The letters in the MoSCoW prioritisation method stand for...
e_en: MoSCoW sorts requirements into Must have, Should have, Could have and Won't have (this time).

q: Bagaimana skor RICE dihitung?
e: Skor RICE = (jangkauan x dampak x keyakinan) dibagi usaha; makin tinggi makin diprioritaskan.
q_en: How is a RICE score calculated?
e_en: RICE = (reach x impact x confidence) divided by effort; the higher the score, the higher the priority.

q: Fitur X: jangkauan 2.000 pengguna, dampak 2, keyakinan 80%, usaha 4 orang-bulan. Berapa skor RICE-nya?
q_en: Feature X: reach 2,000 users, impact 2, confidence 80%, effort 4 person-months. What is its RICE score?

q: Mengapa roadmap berbasis tema atau hasil yang diharapkan lebih fleksibel daripada daftar fitur dengan tanggal?
o: Karena arah tetap jelas sementara fitur bisa disesuaikan saat prioritas berubah
Karena tidak perlu persetujuan siapa pun
e: Tema dan hasil menjaga arah strategis tanpa mengikat tim pada fitur dan tanggal yang mungkin berubah.
q_en: Why is a roadmap built on themes or outcomes more flexible than a feature list with dates?
o_en: The direction stays clear while features can adapt when priorities change
e_en: Themes and outcomes keep the strategic direction without tying the team to features and dates that may change.

q: Bagaimana struktur dasar papan di Trello?
o: Board berisi list, dan list berisi kartu
e: Di Trello, satu board berisi beberapa list dan setiap list berisi kartu tugas.
q_en: What is the basic structure of a Trello board?
o_en: A board holds lists and lists hold cards
A table of rows and columns
e_en: In Trello, a board holds several lists and each list holds task cards.

q: Pada papan kanban, apa yang diwakili setiap kolom?
o: Tahap pengerjaan, misalnya To Do, Doing, Done
e: Kolom kanban menggambarkan tahap alur kerja, dan kartu bergerak dari kiri ke kanan.
q_en: On a kanban board, what does each column represent?
o_en: A stage of work, such as To Do, Doing, Done
e_en: Kanban columns show workflow stages and cards move from left to right.

q: Fitur apa pada kartu yang dipakai untuk memecah satu tugas menjadi langkah-langkah kecil?
e: Checklist memecah satu kartu menjadi sub-tugas yang bisa dicentang satu per satu.
q_en: Which card feature breaks one task into small steps?
e_en: A checklist splits one card into sub-tasks that can be ticked off one by one.

q: Untuk apa tenggat (due date) dipakai pada kartu tugas?
o: Menandai kapan tugas harus selesai agar bisa dipantau
e: Due date menunjukkan batas waktu tugas sehingga keterlambatan mudah terlihat.
q_en: What is a due date used for on a task card?
o_en: Marking when the task must be finished so it can be monitored
e_en: A due date shows a task's deadline so lateness is easy to see.

q: Di papan kanban, kolom 'Review' menumpuk 15 kartu sementara kolom lain kosong. Apa artinya?
o: Ada hambatan di tahap review yang perlu diatasi
e: Penumpukan di satu kolom menandakan bottleneck di tahap tersebut.
q_en: On a kanban board the 'Review' column piles up 15 cards while the other columns are empty. What does this mean?
o_en: There is a bottleneck in the review stage to address
The board was set up wrongly
e_en: A pile-up in one column signals a bottleneck at that stage.

q: Apa yang dimaksud manajemen rilis?
o: Merencanakan, menjadwalkan, dan mengendalikan peluncuran perubahan ke pengguna
e: Manajemen rilis mengatur bagaimana dan kapan perubahan produk atau sistem diluncurkan secara terkendali.
q_en: What is release management?
o_en: Planning, scheduling and controlling the launch of changes to users
e_en: Release management controls how and when product or system changes are launched.

q: Apa isi catatan rilis (release notes)?
o: Ringkasan perubahan dan perbaikan yang ada dalam rilis
e: Catatan rilis menjelaskan kepada pengguna apa yang baru, diubah, dan diperbaiki.
q_en: What do release notes contain?
o_en: A summary of the changes and fixes in the release
e_en: Release notes tell users what is new, changed and fixed.

q: Apa yang sebaiknya ada sebelum sistem baru go-live?
o: Persetujuan hasil UAT oleh pemilik bisnis
e: Sebelum go-live, hasil user acceptance testing perlu disetujui pemilik bisnis sebagai tanda sistem layak dipakai.
q_en: What should be in place before a new system goes live?
o_en: Business owner sign-off of the UAT results
e_en: Before go-live, the user acceptance test results should be signed off by the business owner.

q: Apa fungsi rencana rollback?
o: Mengembalikan ke versi sebelumnya bila rilis bermasalah
e: Rencana rollback menyiapkan langkah kembali ke kondisi sebelumnya bila rilis gagal.
q_en: What is a rollback plan for?
o_en: Returning to the previous version if a release goes wrong
Speeding up the launch of new features
e_en: A rollback plan sets out the steps to return to the earlier state if a release fails.

q: Sistem lama dimatikan akhir pekan dan datanya dipindah ke sistem baru yang langsung dipakai Senin. Kegiatan peralihan ini disebut...
e: Cutover adalah peralihan terjadwal dari sistem lama ke sistem baru, termasuk migrasi data.
q_en: The old system is switched off at the weekend and its data moved to a new system used from Monday. This transition is called...
e_en: A cutover is the scheduled switch from the old system to the new one, including data migration.
